verdict.rationale: Gusto now offers company formation, EIN registration, banking and compliance filings for founders, so equity-fundraising documents are a fair question for this kind of product. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions generating or e-signing SAFEs or convertible notes on standard terms. The formation and compliance features are adjacent and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As a founder, I can generate and sign SAFEs or convertible notes on standard terms without drafting from scratch
